symbols.name: exponent gap
symbols.meaning: A fixed constant, $2^{-182}$, which sets the saving in the exponent $1-\kappa$ of the bound.
symbols.quote: Here $\kappa = 2^{-182}$ is a fixed constant, so $(\lg n)^{1-\kappa}$ grows slightly more slowly than $\lg n$.

symbols.name: base-2 logarithm
symbols.meaning: The base-2 logarithm, applied to the input length n.
symbols.quote: In the bound below, $\lg$ is the base-2 logarithm and $n$ is the input length.

relations.quote: Schoolbook multiplication is a method for [Exact integer multiplication](exact-integer-multiplication.md): it outputs the full product of two $n$-bit inputs, and it is exact for every input.
